text: Right, sports news and we're getting excited about October when Australia hosts not just one but three Rugby League World Cups. The men's, women's and wheelchair championships all happening here, plus New Zealand and Papua New Guinea.

speaker: alice
text: That's massive for the sport! Meanwhile the A-League finals are heating up with some cracking semi-final action this weekend. And looking ahead, the Matildas are gearing up for their Mexico clash.

speaker: charlie
text: State of Origin's just around the corner too - first game May 27th at Accor Stadium. Nothing beats the passion of Origin to get everyone talking footy again.
